mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (potassium, sodium) and dehydration may lower seizure threshold, increasing bupropion's seizure risk; bupropion may also increase sympathomimetic effects from diuretic-induced compensatory responses.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate hydration, and consider alternative diuretics or dose adjustment; counsel patient on seizure precautions.
